_comment: WHI-1447 acceptance bundles, cut deterministically from the frozen WHI-1436 corpus by `main.py corpus cohort` / `main.py corpus split` (docs/references/v1-acceptance.md §2). The corpus bundle itself is unchanged.

sor_cohort.command: uv run python main.py corpus cohort --bundle data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/bundle --output data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/sor_cohort

bundle_tuning.command: uv run python main.py corpus split --bundle data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/bundle --split tuning --output data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/bundle_tuning

bundle_report.command: uv run python main.py corpus split --bundle data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/bundle --split report --output data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/bundle_report

sor_cohort_tuning.command: uv run python main.py corpus split --bundle data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/sor_cohort --split tuning --output data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/sor_cohort_tuning

sor_cohort_report.command: uv run python main.py corpus split --bundle data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/sor_cohort --split report --output data/corpus/mantle-5src-101082044/sor_cohort_report
